proposed_capability: MoonWake /the-closers P83-P03-P141-P124-P04: repair first-run GUI and explicit CLI launch inconsistencies by reusing the already tested auto-start process admission and unique-install selection, while preserving new-Sim skill guidance, explicit launch consent and player-owned saves.
player_save_control_impact: Manual chooser and CLI launch only dispatch after explicit user selection/confirm and the same validated Windows read-only process inventory checks as auto-start. Never select, read or modify saves, CAS fields, actual skill levels, windows input settings or game files. No background actions or new GUI telemetry.
expected_outcome: Single install with both EA executables is picked once (x64) in GUI, two distinct installs require explicit player selection, GUI/CLI manual launch does not dispatch duplicate game when one already runs or inventory is ambiguous, and plan validation/consent happen before process effects.
negative_tests: Unconfirmed CLI launch does not dispatch or scan Windows process inventory
One active game never causes a second instance from GUI or CLI
Two running games and malformed inventory block manual launch
Missing or untrusted manually chosen executable is rejected before dispatch
One root with 32/64 executables defaults to x64; distinct roots remain ambiguous
Existing-save plan remains player-controlled; critical needs/income/skill suggestions are advisory only
No new save or game file writes, OS input or EA authentication changes
rollback_path: Revert isolated feature PR; previous Start-BetterInstincts.cmd, scripts smart startup, first-run planning and protected user saves remain unchanged.
unresolved_unknowns: This connector cannot launch or observe the user's local Windows Sims, EA processes, Create-a-Sim or real save slots
Auto-Start's process-name observation does not authenticate exact Windows process image path
Interprocess race between separate simultaneous manual launchers still needs local Windows proof
decision_rationale: P83 identified direct process dispatch in the manual GUI/CLI despite duplicate protection in auto mode and false ambiguity for dual executables in GUI. P03 repairs a bounded existing-owner bug, P141 rejects adding unobserved CAS effect control, P124 reuses one canonical process/installation selection owner, P04 retains Windows/EA evidence and physical host admission.
